nodes.description: JellyInuToken.transfer(address _to,uint _value) public payable; delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
JellyInuToken.transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable; mutates allowance and balanceOf mappings without SafeMath
JellyInuToken.approve(address _spender,uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval
JellyInuToken.approveAndCall(address spender,uint256 addedValue) owner-guarded unchecked mint that overwrites balanceOf[spender]
JellyInuToken constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and mints the whole supply to msg.sender
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf holding token balances
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance holding spend approvals
address private owner; privileged access-control state used by approveAndCall
uint constant public decimals = 18 used as exponent in supply/balance scaling
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used as owner, spender and transfer source
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)); unchecked multiplication that mint/overwrites arbitrary balances in approveAndCall
require(msg.sender == owner); owner-only guard protecting the approveAndCall mint path
spender of jelly_approveAndCall; address whose balance is set
addedValue of jelly_approveAndCall; unscaled amount multiplied by 10**decimals

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transfer supplies msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom
transferFrom compares msg.sender against _from and uses it as allowance spender to bypass the approval branch
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping for _from/msg.sender
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for _from and _to
transferFrom executes unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value which can underflow
transferFrom executes unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value which can underflow
transferFrom executes unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value which can overflow
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key
approveAndCall executes balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) allowing unchecked multiplication overflow and arbitrary balance inflation
approveAndCall is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) before minting
msg.sender is tested against owner to authorise the mint in approveAndCall
owner state variable is read as the privileged reference in approveAndCall
decimals is used as the exponent in 10**uint256(decimals) scaling inside approveAndCall
constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply, minting the full supply
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) with unchecked multiplication
constructor assigns privileged owner state from msg.sender
constructor uses msg.sender as owner and initial balance holder
the approveAndCall mint operation writes a computed value directly into the balanceOf mapping
